payload.objective: Find and screen the first realistic Vera Works revenue opportunity under the $0 seed-capital constraint using fresh evidence, then advance the best viable candidate to the next valid operating state.
payload.scope: Current market discovery, platform-rule verification, opportunity screening, and recommendation/selection. No external application, account creation, spending, contract acceptance, or customer communication is authorized by this event.
acceptance_criteria: At least one concrete current revenue opportunity or one evidence-backed outbound channel is screened against compensation, fees, AI/platform rules, deadline/acceptance criteria, IP/privacy, human/legal requirements, effort, expected net revenue, and payment likelihood.
Obviously invalid, stale, inaccessible, policy-conflicting, or economically irrational candidates are rejected mechanically.
The best viable candidate is persisted as canonical operating state before any external effect is requested.
